name: get_stock_quote
description: Get the current stock quote for a ticker symbol: price, daily change, volume, market cap, P/E, 52-week range. Data is a deterministic simulation labeled source=simulated.

name: get_market_overview
description: Get major market indices (S&P 500, NASDAQ, DOW, Russell 2000), VIX volatility, treasury yields, and sentiment indicators.

name: get_historical_prices
description: Get historical daily OHLCV (open/high/low/close/volume) prices for a stock over the last N trading days (max 252).

days.description: Number of trading days of history (max 252) (Default: 30)

name: get_sector_performance
description: Get daily and year-to-date performance for all 11 GICS market sectors.
